en.smartDesc: Gradisen SMART is an intelligent property management work assignment system that digitizes maintenance, inventory, safety, and cross-department coordination. It includes a native mobile app for frontline staff and a privileged web portal for supervisors and administrators, backed by an on-premise server. Connectivity supports both private intranet and public internet access, while the mobile app remains offline-first: users can create and update work orders without connectivity, with delta synchronization and conflict resolution on reconnection. A five-tier RBAC hierarchy enforces server-authoritative permissions across both clients. Key features include automatic material preselection from historical work orders, real-time inventory deduction on completion, and configurable risk-assessment triggers (e.g., ladder height >1.8 m, electrical work >400 W) requiring supervisor approval. Licensing uses a multi-factor hardware fingerprint with tolerance for legitimate upgrades, and all operational data and attachments are stored locally on the server. Pilot deployments confirmed reduced manual reporting effort, improved inventory accuracy, and stronger safety compliance. Iterative feedback simplified the mobile UI and improved sync reliability.
en.smartFeature1Text: Create and update work orders with zero connectivity; delta sync and conflict resolution kick in on reconnection.
en.smartFeature2Text: A server-authoritative permission hierarchy enforced identically across the mobile app and the web portal.
en.smartFeature3Text: Materials auto-preselected from historical work orders, then deducted in real time the moment a job is closed.
en.smartFeature4Text: Configurable risk triggers — ladders above 1.8 m, electrical work above 400 W — route jobs for supervisor approval.

en.gdSenseDesc: An autonomous patrol robot designed for small-to-medium warehouses to detect packaging damage and verify SKUs without infrastructure modifications. Built on an NVIDIA Jetson edge-AI pipeline with ROS, it integrates a YOLO-based vision model, RGB-D camera, and 2D LiDAR to navigate fixed routes and identify structural anomalies externally with over 80% accuracy.
en.novaSenseDesc: An advanced Edge AI system for warehouse inventory counting and volumetric estimation. Evolved from a YOLO bounding-box model into a sophisticated 2D-3D spatial fusion pipeline combining Grounding DINO, SAM, and MASt3R. Engineered a custom point-cloud denoising engine and elevation map voxelization to accurately measure irregular cargo shapes.
en.sittingDirectorDesc: A smart chair system utilizing an ESP-32, FSRs, and infrared sensors to detect and correct poor posture in real time. Implemented on-device pose estimation via TensorFlow Lite and Google MoveNet, syncing data to a custom Android app via Firebase and BLE. Designed 3D-printed mechanical components for physical posture adjustment.

hk.smartDesc: Gradisen SMART 是一個智能物業管理工作分派系統，將維修、庫存、安全及跨部門協作全面數碼化。前線員工使用原生手機應用程式，主管及管理員則使用具特權的網頁後台，兩者由同一部本地部署伺服器支撐，可經內部網絡或公開互聯網連線。手機應用程式以離線優先運作：沒有網絡時仍可建立及更新工作單，重新連線後會進行增量同步並解決衝突。五層 RBAC 權限架構在兩個用戶端一致地執行由伺服器授權的權限控制，並配合根據歷史工作單自動預選物料、工作完成後即時扣減庫存，以及可配置的風險評估觸發條件（例如梯具高度超過 1.8 米、電力工程功率超過 400 瓦）自動轉交主管審批。授權機制採用多因素硬件指紋，並可容忍合理的硬件升級；所有營運數據及附件均儲存在伺服器本地。試點部署證實可減少人手匯報工作、提升庫存準確度並加強安全合規，並透過持續的用戶回饋簡化手機介面及提升同步可靠性。
hk.smartFeature1Text: 即使完全沒有網絡，仍可建立及更新工作單；重新連線後自動增量同步並解決衝突。
hk.smartFeature2Text: 由伺服器授權的權限架構，於手機應用程式與網頁後台一致執行。
hk.smartFeature3Text: 根據歷史工作單自動預選物料，工作單完成後即時扣減庫存。
hk.smartFeature4Text: 可配置風險觸發條件（梯具高於 1.8 米、電力工程高於 400 瓦），自動轉交主管審批。

hk.gdSenseDesc: 為中小型倉庫設計的自主巡邏機器人，用於檢測包裝損傷和驗證SKU，無需基礎設施改造。基於NVIDIA Jetson邊緣AI管道和ROS構建，集成了基於YOLO的視覺模型、RGB-D攝像頭和2D激光雷達，以超過80%的準確度沿著固定路線導航並識別外部結構異常。
hk.novaSenseDesc: 用於倉庫庫存計數和體積估計的先進邊緣AI系統。從YOLO邊界框模型發展而來，已演變為結合Grounding DINO、SAM和MASt3R的複雜2D-3D空間融合管道。設計了自定義點雲去噪引擎和高程圖體素化，以準確測量不規則貨物形狀。
hk.sittingDirectorDesc: 使用ESP-32、FSR和紅外傳感器的智能椅系統，可實時檢測和糾正不良姿勢。通過TensorFlow Lite和Google MoveNet實現設備上姿勢估計，通過Firebase和BLE將數據同步到自定義Android應用程序。設計3D打印機械部件用於物理姿勢調整。
